Credit cards and personal checks are not accepted')

note: Primitive, heavily wooded campground among Butterfield, May and Mill Ponds; most drive-in sites are small and only a dozen take a 23-ft rig. Canoe and kayak rentals and a launch for non-motorized boats; the Monadnock-Sunapee Greenway crosses the park. Little or no cell service. --Claude
summary: Park page + 7-2026 map/info + RA per-site read (35 listed): 41 sites, 14 standard drive-in of which 12 take 23 ft+ (max 38), six sites first-come; pit toilets + water, no showers; $29, cash only on site; 2026 season 05-08 to 10-24. Pond kept on RA's per-site PONDFRONT tags (imagery canopy-blind). Phone RA call centre -> park office.
flags: PHONE: 877-647-2757 (ReserveAmerica call centre) -> 603-863-2860 (park page 'Park Office: 603-863-2860', RA 'Park office phone number 603-863-2860', Camping Information 'Office (603) 863-2860').

WATERFRONT (stored pond, not --AWH; old evidence was the 2017 map only): RA per-site notes 'This site is a PONDFRONT site' on standard drive-in sites 001 (38 ft), 002 (24), 006 (24), 010 (24), 015 (24), 023 (38) - all sold by the night on RA - plus 014 (20 ft), pop-up 011 and tent 012. 7-2026 map: 2 on the Butterfield Pond north shore by the park road (~43.2334,-72.1158, approximate), 6 at the Narrows on May Pond (~43.2335,-72.1135), 10/14/15 on the May Pond north-east cove (~43.2318,-72.1056), 23 by the barn on May Pond's east shore (~43.2312,-72.1043), 1 on Vickery Pond (~43.2352,-72.1168); coordinates read off the map against NAIP, no RA GIS for this park. Esri and NAIP show continuous canopy down to the shore everywhere (illegible, not a veto). Kept as pond on the per-site reservation flag (curation doc: canopy-blind imagery defers to per-site reservation data); reviewer note: the task rule 'under continuous canopy is a view' would make it a pond-view call, and the vocabulary has no pond-view value, so the alternative is not waterfront.
booking.fcfs added some_sites (map: 5, 8, 13, 31, 33, 34 not reservable; RA nevertheless lists 013).
Rig length: 12 of 14 standard sites take 23 ft+ (RA); the rest of the 41 are tent, pop-up, lean-to or remote. No pull-through data (RA Driveway Entry blank).

season 05-01..10-31 approximate -> 05-08..10-24 (2026 schedule); the map's 'Memorial Day weekend through Columbus Day weekend' is the reservable window, with primitive (pre-season) walk-in camping from May 8.

Pin 43.23333,-72.10778 sits in the woods on May Pond's north shore between site 8 and the 9-20 loop, inside the campground's ~1 km spread (site 1 at Rt 31 to site 35 by Mill Pond); ~250 m from the 9-20 loop, no RA GIS to centre on. No move proposed.
